title: Pan-Fried Norwegian Goose Skewers
description: A quick and delicious Norwegian-inspired dish featuring tender goose skewers, pan-fried to perfection. Best served hot with a side of your favorite vegetables.

ingredients.name: Goose breast or thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim any excess fat

ingredients.name: Skewers (wooden or metal)
ingredients.notes: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes before use

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-smoke-point oil for frying

instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat.
2. Thread the goose pieces onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
3. Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
4. Add the skewers to the preheated skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
5. Remove the skewers from the skillet and let them rest for a few minutes.
6. Serve the pan-fried goose skewers hot with your favorite sides.
